session.title: Marker Quest
session.elevator_pitch: A fixture game whose export embeds SUPERSEDES markers in decision text.
session.core_loop: Walk to item, grab it, return.

decisions.title: One-screen map
decisions.decision: The whole game fits on one screen.
decisions.alternatives: Scrolling map; rejected as scope creep.

decisions.title: Grab is automatic on contact
decisions.decision: SUPERSEDES D002. Walking over the item grabs it.

superseded.title: Explicit grab button
superseded.decision: Player presses a button to grab the item.

simulation_log.heading: Beat 1: First Contact
simulation_log.text: Player spawns by the door (see D001 for the one-screen framing).
